transformation: Add a YAML comment before the build job.
rationale: YAML comments are discarded by the parser and cannot change workflow execution.

transformation: Convert matrix lists from YAML flow style to block style.
rationale: Flow and block sequence syntax represent the same ordered YAML sequence.

transformation: Change quoting style for equivalent scalar values.
rationale: The resulting YAML scalar values are unchanged after parsing.

transformation: Reverse the order of push and pull_request mapping keys.
rationale: YAML mapping-key order does not alter the set or configuration of workflow triggers.

transformation: Add an explicit job-level if: ${{ success() }} condition.
rationale: GitHub Actions applies success() as the implicit default job condition when no status-check condition is supplied.
